name: The Foot of the Cross, or the Sorrows of Mary
name_pt: Ao Pé da Cruz, ou as Dores de Maria
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's treatise of 1858 on the sorrows of Our Lady: nine chapters on the martyrdom of Mary, the foot of the cross, her compassion and the devotion of the Seven Dolours, in which each chapter is divided into sections.
desc_pt: O tratado de Faber (1858) sobre as dores de Nossa Senhora: nove capítulos sobre o martírio de Maria, o pé da cruz, a sua compaixão e a devoção às Sete Dores, cada capítulo dividido em seções.
editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (London: Richardson and Son, 1858)
edition: The Foot of the Cross, or the Sorrows of Mary (London: Richardson and Son, 1858), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The preface is kept; the analytic table of contents and the advertisements are dropped. Faber's sections are headings within each chapter.
